gloss: complete set of volumes; all volumes

definitions.gloss: complete set of volumes; all volumes
definitions.explanation: The entire set of volumes in a series, such as a manga, novel series, or encyclopedia. Frequently used when buying or discussing the full collection.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{全巻|ぜんかん}⟦{揃|そろ}えた→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。
examples.english: I collected all the volumes of that manga.

examples.japanese: {全巻|ぜんかん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's cheaper if you buy the complete set.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全巻|ぜんかん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: When moving, it was tough packing the complete manga sets into cardboard boxes.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in manga and book culture. Online retailers frequently offer {全巻|ぜんかん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (complete set) deals. Also used for encyclopedias and other multi-volume works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全巻|ぜんかん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (complete set)
- {全巻|ぜんかん}⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (to collect all volumes)
- {全巻|ぜんかん}⟦{読破|どくは}→読破：19606_dokuha⟧ (reading all volumes through)
- {全巻|ぜんかん}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (all volumes free)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既刊|きかん}→既刊：17885_kikan⟧: already published volumes — the volumes released so far in an ongoing series
- ⟦{全集|ぜんしゅう}→全集：11783_zenshuu⟧: collected works — a comprehensive collection of an author's writings
